## At every turn

**Word Power 52 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Always and everywhere.

### Usage

1. M. C. Mary Com finally managed to achieve her goal, although she had met with opposition at every turn.
2. They did their best to frustrate my efforts at every turn.

### Your turn

Use “at every turn” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
